expected: At high redshift, metallicity relations can disagree because galaxies evolved, or because calibrations changed the measuring scale. If the relation genuinely evolved, that would be a fact about the enrichment history of young galaxies. But an apparent offset could instead be a fact about strong-line recipes, reference frames, or scale conversions rather than galaxies. How do we tell evolution from calibration?
